# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Obey `AGENTS.md` and each applicable file in `.github/instructions`.

Before a high-risk contract change, state the source authority, data owner,
exact failures, and executable counterexamples.

High-risk changes include public APIs, cross-package contracts, partial data,
remote fallbacks, and upstream compatibility differences.
